lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr12Ga2Sn2 (reduced formula Zr6GaSn) is orthorhombic with space group Amm2 (No. 38) and 16 atoms in the unit cell across 6 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for Ga, Sn, and Zr centers, with each Ga and Sn surrounded by 12 Zr neighbors, and Zr centers exhibiting 12 neighbors comprising Ga, Sn, and Zr. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component containing all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Zr-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, as well as edge-sharing between Ga- and Sn-centered polyhedra.
